title: Four seconds, and the face holds
purpose: The shortest useful shot of a person doing something, made short deliberately because that is how long a face lasts.
keeps: the face, on most seeds, because the shot ends before the engine redraws it
three variants, so the pick has something to choose between
cannot: a long take - that is what this entry exists to avoid
measured: at 4 s a walk toward the camera kept the face on 2 of 3 seeds; at 6 s it kept it on 0 of 3
hint: The shortest useful shot of a person doing something, made short deliberately because that is how long a face lasts.
